newsitem.title: USA: NASD fines Alex. Brown over Regulation S sales.
newsitem.headline: NASD fines Alex. Brown over Regulation S sales.

text.p: NASD Regulation Inc said Monday it fined Alex. Brown & Sons and one of its registered representatives in connection with the sale of Regulation S securities by one of the firm's customers.
The regulatory arm of the National Association of Securities Dealers levied a $100,000 fine on Alex. Brown and a $50,000 fine on the registered representative, Beaumont Bianchi.
Alex. Brown and Beaumont Bianchi also agreed to return $150,000 in commissions related to the sale of the securities, NASD said.
In addition, NASD cited Alex. Brown for failing to put adequate supervisory procedures in place.

NASD said it was the first time it has taken disciplinary action in connection with the sale of Regulation S securities, which do not have to be registered with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission because the offerings are considered being made outside the United States.
To qualify, the securities of the six companies in question could not be sold, directly or indirectly, to any U.S. company or citizen until 40 days after the offering.
